messages:
elaine: Hey team — submitted an expense for last week's client trip but only got mobile boarding passes (Apple Wallet) and no emailed PDF receipt from the airline. I uploaded a screenshot of the boarding pass + my card statement. Is that sufficient for the fare? cc @samir :thinking:

samir: Short answer: usually yes, but depends. We require an itemized fare receipt OR an e-ticket/confirmation that shows the fare details. If the airline doesn't provide that, we accept a boarding pass screenshot PLUS proof of payment (card statement) showing the charge. :white_check_mark:

samir: For clarity, acceptable combos are:
- airline fare receipt (PDF or in-app) OR e-ticket confirmation (PDF/email) alone; OR
- boarding pass screenshot + card statement showing the airline charge and last 4 digits.

samir: If you have an in-app receipt/screen that shows passenger name, flight #, fare, and transaction id, upload that instead of a separate PDF. Please add a short note to the expense that the airline only provided mobile boarding passes.

mike: I ran into this yesterday. I only had the Wallet boarding pass and the airline app shows nothing under receipts. I uploaded the boarding pass screenshot + a pic of my bank transaction. Will that clear?

samir: Yep, that should clear it. Make sure the bank transaction line includes the merchant name (airline) and the charged amount. If the description is generic (e.g., a travel aggregator), try to include any booking confirmation email too.

julia: Quick Q — how does this affect per-diem? I logged travel day for the flight day but no meal receipts that day. Does the boarding pass act as proof for per-diem eligibility?

samir: Boarding pass is fine to verify travel dates. For per-diem we need proof that travel occurred on that day (boarding pass or itinerary). You don't need meal receipts to claim per-diem, but still follow the per-diem rates and caps in the policy.

samir: Other practical tips:
```
Required items for digital-only airline cases:
- Screenshot of boarding pass (passenger name & flight # visible)
- Card/bank statement line showing airline charge (last 4 digits ok)
- Optional: booking confirmation email or in-app receipt
- Expense note: "Airline did not send fare PDF; attaching boarding pass + bank txn"
```

samir: If this is international, keep the original currency amounts. Attach a small note about conversion and the date-rate used (we accept the Google conversion screenshot or the exchange rate from xe.com).

people-ops-bot: Reminder — receipts required for any single item > $75. If missing, expenses may be flagged for follow-up.

elaine: Awesome, thanks @samir — I added the bank statement + note. Appreciate the clarity. :pray:

mike: tagging this so others know: upload both items and add the note. saved me from a follow-up. :thumbsup:

samir: One more edge case: if you paid on a company card and the charge is visible in our card activity, boarding pass alone is fine since we can match the charge internally. If you paid personal and got refunded/cancelled, include the refund proof too.

elaine: Got it. I'll mark the expense as "travel - airfare" and include the boarding pass + txn. Thanks everyone.
